camel_example: aliyun aiworkspace POST /api/v1/workspaces --region cn-hangzhou --header "Content-Type=application/json" --body '{"Description":"这是一个工作空间描述示例。","ResourceGroupId":"rg-acfmwp7rkyq0000","DisplayName":"demo工作空间","WorkspaceName":"workspace_example","EnvTypes":["dev"]}'
kebab_example: aliyun aiworkspace create-workspace --workspace-name workspace_example --description '这是一个工作空间描述示例。' --display-name 'demo工作空间' --env-types dev --resource-group-id rg-acfmwp7rkyq0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateWorkspace

parameters.example: 这是一个工作空间描述示例。
parameters.help_en: The description of the workspace. The description cannot exceed 80 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 工作空间描述，不超过80个字符
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: We recommend that you name the workspace based on its business attribute to facilitate identification of its purpose. If you do not configure this parameter, the workspace name is used by default
parameters.help_zh: 建议基于业务属性命名，便于标识工作空间用途。如果不配置，默认为工作空间名称
parameters.name: display_name

parameters.help_en:
The environments included in the workspace:
The simple mode contains only the production environment (prod).
The standard mode contains both the development environment (dev) and the production environment (prod)
parameters.help_zh:
工作空间包含的环境：
简单模式只有生产环境（prod）。
标准模式包含开发环境（dev）和生产环境（prod）
parameters.name: env_types

parameters.help_en: The resource group ID. For information about how to obtain the resource group ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/151181.html
parameters.help_zh: 资源组ID。如何获取资源组ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/151181.html
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the workspace. The format is as follows:
The length is 3 to 23 characters and can contain letters, underscores (_), or digits.
It must start with a letter (uppercase or lowercase).
It must be unique within the current region
parameters.help_zh:
工作空间名称。格式如下：
长度为3~23 个字符，可以包含字母、下划线或数字。
必须以大小写字母开头。
当前地域内唯一
parameters.name: workspace_name
